claim: The People's Party and Vox together win at least 176 of the 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies in Spain's general election on Sunday 29 November 2026.

runs.scenario: If the count is 99.8% complete at 05:00 CET and gives the parties 175 seats, but reaches 100% later that morning and gives them 176, one reader could resolve NO because 05:00 is the cutoff for all results. Another could resolve YES because the wording places the time limit only on the fallback to an incomplete count.
runs.yes_requires: Spain's general election must be held within the stated 09:00–23:59 Europe/Madrid window on 29 November 2026, and the qualifying provisional count must give the People's Party and Vox at least 176 of the 350 Congress seats combined. All Partido Popular lists count, including Partit Popular lists and the UPN–PP joint list in Navarre.

runs.decided_by: The Spanish Interior Ministry's provisional results website (resultados.29neleccionesgenerales.es), or if unreadable, the ministry's provisional count as reported by RTVE or EFE.

runs.scenario: The ministry site cannot be read, and RTVE's report of the provisional count gives the defined PP candidacies plus Vox 175 seats while EFE's gives 176 (or one outlet counts the Navarre UPN–PP seat with the People's Party and the other lists it separately). The criterion names RTVE or EFE with no priority or reconciliation rule, so one careful reader resolves YES and the other NO on the same facts.
